scenes.name: wallet-entry
scenes.caption:
DYNAMIC | The shared wallet session is available throughout Aetheris.
This recording demonstrates the live sign-in UI and the implemented signing path.

scenes.name: dynamic-auth-options
scenes.caption:
Dynamic provides the email, wallet and existing-passkey sign-in choices.
No wallet is authenticated and no signature is requested in this recording.

scenes.name: separate-executor-permission
scenes.caption:
Agent task authority has its own interface and requires the owner approval.
Authentication alone does not grant executor authority or spend wallet funds.

scenes.name: dynamic-provider-wiring
scenes.caption:
DynamicContextProvider owns the shared primary wallet and authentication state.
The SIWE message explicitly separates login from token payments and delegation.

scenes.name: dynamic-signing-path
scenes.caption:
Dynamic primaryWallet.getWalletClient() supplies the task-signing client.
The app requests separate typed signatures for the task and exact USDC payment.

scenes.name: historical-settlement-evidence
scenes.caption:
Historical on-chain receipts can be inspected without connecting a wallet.
These existing receipts are not a new authenticated run in this recording.

scenes.name: dynamic-evidence-limits
scenes.caption:
The integration is implemented; a successful live login/signature is not filmed here.
Resolve the documented domain/service blockers before recording a fresh paid run.
